name: Crystal Vale
summary: Tucked away in the far northwestern corner of Silithus, the Crystal Vale is a remote canyon dominated by jagged mineral spires and swirling elemental forces. Earth and air elementals roam its rocky flats, guarding rich veins of raw ore. It is also a site of potent summoning magic, deeply tied to the ancient elemental lords.

sections.title: A Confluence of Stone and Wind
sections.body: The Crystal Vale stands distinct from the barren desert sands of southern Silithus. Framed by steep cliffs, the basin is filled with shimmering crystalloid formations, roaming earthen elementals, and roaring whirlwinds of living air. Rich deposits of thorium draw occasional daring prospectors, but the vale is far from quiet. The elemental beings here are inherently hostile to intruders, guarding a realm that feels steeped in the primal conflicts of primordial Azeroth.

sections.title: The Slumber of the Windseeker
sections.body: Beyond its minerals and native spirits, the Crystal Vale holds deep significance for ancient elemental powers. It is here that Highlord Demitrian lingers, harboring the secrets of Prince Thunderaan, the Windseeker. Those who gather the severed elemental bindings of the fallen prince and the rarest forged metals are directed to this valley, where the imprisoned lord of air can be coaxed from his bindings and challenged in open battle.

faq.q: Where is the Crystal Vale located?
faq.answer: The Crystal Vale is situated in the far northwestern reaches of Silithus, nestled against the mountainous rim that borders the desert.
The canyon is primarily populated by aggressive air and earth elementals that drift and stomp around the mineral outcrops.

faq.q: Who is Highlord Demitrian and why is he here?
faq.answer: Highlord Demitrian is a solitary hermit dwelling in the vale who holds profound knowledge of Prince Thunderaan. He aids champions capable of reuniting the Windseeker's bindings to summon the elemental prince.

faq.q: What is the Ravaged Twilight Camp?
faq.answer: It is the wreckage of a Twilight's Hammer encampment within the vale, overrun and shattered by the violent elemental denizens that claim the canyon.

angles.text: The craggy edges and canyon walls of the Crystal Vale are known to house valuable veins of rich thorium, making it a lucrative though hazardous destination for high-skill miners.
The raw friction between earth and air spirits here serves as a potent reminder of the unbridled chaos of unrestrained elementals across Silithus.
